teaser.en: Its name means 'roar', a sign of dominance and success, and it is used against convulsions and spiritual ailments.
teaser.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'kunguruma', ishara ya utawala na mafanikio, na hutumika dhidi ya degedege na maradhi ya kiroho.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rina mana ya 'kuvuma', alama ya ukulu na ushindi, na nkuhumirwa kpwa nyuni na makongo ga pepho.

summary.en: *Mvuma* is a coastal shrub or small tree with dense flower heads and very hard wood. It is used against convulsions and spiritual ailments, and its wood for household items.
summary.sw: *Mvuma* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa pwani wenye vichwa vya maua vilivyosongamana na mbao ngumu sana. Hutumika dhidi ya degedege na maradhi ya kiroho, na mbao zake hutumika kutengeneza vifaa vya nyumbani.
summary.dg: *Mvuma* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa pwani wenye mafungu ga maruwa ganayobanana na nyama za muhi nyifu sana. Nkuhumirwa kpwa nyuni na makongo ga pepho, na nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa kuhenda vyombo vya nyumbani.

about.en: *Mvuma* is a shrub or small tree of the mint family, with leaves in opposite pairs. Its small flowers are packed into dense heads. The wood is very hard.
about.sw: *Mvuma* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya minanaa, wenye majani yaliyokaa kwa jozi zinazokabiliana. Maua yake madogo yamesongamana katika vichwa. Mbao zake ni ngumu sana.
about.dg: *Mvuma* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa jamii ya *mint*, wenye makodza ganayomera mairi-mairi ganalolana. Maruwage madide ganabanana phamwenga kuhenda mafungu. Nyama za muhi ni nyifu sana.

where.sw: Hukua katika nyika ya vichaka ya pwani.

uses.en: It is used to treat convulsions and spiritual ailments. The very hard wood is made into household items.
uses.sw: Hutumika kutibu degedege na maradhi ya kiroho. Mbao zake ngumu sana hutengenezwa vifaa vya nyumbani.
uses.dg: Nkuhumirwa kuphoza nyuni na makongo ga pepho. Nyama za muhi, ambazo ni nyifu sana, nkuhumirwa kuhenda vyombo vya nyumbani.

culture.en: The name *mvuma* means 'roar', a sign of dominance and success, which ties it to the strength people seek against illness and spirits.
culture.sw: Jina *mvuma* lina maana ya 'kunguruma', ishara ya utawala na mafanikio, jambo linalouhusisha na nguvu ambazo watu hutafuta dhidi ya maradhi na pepo.
culture.dg: Dzina *mvuma* rina mana ya 'kuvuma', alama ya ukulu na ushindi, na kpwa hivyo rinahusiana na nguvu ambazo atu anazihendza kupigana na makongo na pepho.

names.en: The Digo name is *mvuma*. In Swahili it is *mvuma nyuki*, and in Giriama *mvuma nyuki* or *mvuma*. No English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Premna chrysoclada*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mvuma*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mvuma nyuki*, na kwa Kigiriama *mvuma nyuki* au *mvuma*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea huuita *Premna chrysoclada*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mvuma*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mvuma nyuki*, na kpwa Chigiryama *mvuma nyuki* au *mvuma*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi anauiha *Premna chrysoclada*.

reason.en: Premna hildebrandtii, same genus, also used for convulsions
reason.sw: Premna hildebrandtii, wa jenasi ile ile, nao pia hutumika kwa degedege
reason.dg: *Muurusa pungu* (*Premna hildebrandtii*), jenasi mwenga, na piya nkuhumirwa kpwa nyuni.

reason.sw: Dawa nyingine ya maradhi ya kiroho
reason.dg: *Mwangajine*, dawa yanjina ya makongo ga pepho.

reason.sw: Wa familia ile ile ya mnanaa
